metadata.source: Port Stress Matrix x Baltic Exchange spot indices
metadata.methodology: Port-call z-score anomaly (port stress matrix) paired with the Baltic index of the hub trade; no correlation or lead time is estimated

alerts.projected_impact: Sharp arrival slowdown at Ras Laffan (Qatar LNG) (Z-Score -2.11σ). Terminal export reduction or weather shutdown dampens cargo stems, softening prompt demand for BLNG.
alerts.recommendation: Monitor forward cargo fixtures for BLNG softening.
